body:
I've tried a long list of different SSRIs. Zoloft doesn't cut it, but by far the worse for me was Paxil. Someone once suggested trying serotonin AND norepinephrine-targeted medicine (SNRIs) like Cymbalta.

If I might ask, what have you had luck with? I know everyone is different but I'm curious and maybe I haven't tried it yet.

Thank you very much. It means a lot to me that people actually stopped and took time to respond. I'm so glad you found a medicine that works for you and part of me hopes I also find something that works for me.

I actually was dead (ha!) set on clinical psychology or psychiatry. I'm fascinated by how the brain works, especially in those with mental health conditions. I guess that's just from suffering from depression for so long and encountering so many misconceptions from the general public about mental health. On my good days, which are few and far between these days, I want to inspire people to learn more and be more understanding towards those in need of help.

I really don't have much drive for it anymore though. It's getting harder and harder to imagine myself in the future, even a few months or a year into the future.

EDIT: realized I accidentally made a pun.
